about_the_game:
Step into the war-torn world of Aura in this exclusive demo of For Evelyn II - Shards of Creation. Experience the first steps of your journey as a Watcher, where your choices shape the fate of the realm. Engage in intense combat, solve intricate puzzles, and interact with a deep narrative that responds to your decisions.

What’s in the Demo?

🔹 Tactical Combat – Test your skills with melee, stealth, and magic-based combat. Face enemies that react dynamically to your approach.
🔹 Exploration & Secrets – Discover hidden paths, and uncover secrets that hint at the larger mysteries of Aura.
🔹 2D & 3D Fusion – Experience beautifully crafted pixel-art characters in detailed 3D environments, blending retro nostalgia with modern visuals.

Your Journey Begins

This demo offers a glimpse into the rich story and gameplay of For Evelyn II. Will you fight with honor, embrace cunning tactics, or forge alliances to survive? The fate of Aura is in your hands.

Wishlist the full game and prepare to continue your adventure when For Evelyn II - Shards of Creation launches!
